text:
Lola (People Ops): Hey team — heads up: Sam's birthday is this Friday (5/3). Planning a small gathering + cake at 3pm in the lounge. Quick poll for cake flavor & dietary needs. Reply with an emoji or short note. :cake:

Raj: Chocolate for me :chocolate_bar: I'll bring cups.

Jess: Vegan please — also GF if possible.

Mike: I can bring balloons + a little speaker for tunes :tada:

Sam: omg you remembered 😅 I'll be there! btw allergic to tree nuts, so please no nuts in my slice.

Kelly: Vanilla for me. Also can someone grab napkins?

Zoe: Remote — can we Zoom in for 5-10 mins? I'll do virtual confetti :sparkles:

BirthdayBot: Reminder scheduled for Fri 2:50pm to pick up cake and set up.

Lola (People Ops): Thanks all. Volunteers so far: Raj (cups), Mike (balloons/speaker), Lola (ordering). @Zoe we'll DM a Zoom link.

Raj: Small ask — can we label options with allergens/calorie tags? I can print labels.

Lola (People Ops): Good call. I'll request nut-free labeling and include ingredient info. Order placed: `order#4829` — details queued with bakery.

Lola (People Ops): Final ask: do we prefer one large cake or a mix of cupcakes (easier to label)? Reply with "cake" or "cupcakes".

Jess: Cupcakes please, easier for vegans to be separate.

Mike: Cake for the dramatic slice reveal :grin:

Kelly: Cupcakes.

Raj: Cupcakes.

Sam: either works for me as long as nut-free option is clear.

Lola (People Ops): Ok — cupcakes it is. Final tally: Chocolate x2, Vanilla x1, Vegan (GF, nut-free) x1. Setup volunteers: Mike (balloons + music), Raj (cups + print labels), Lola (order & pickup).

Lola (People Ops): Quick checklist before Friday: 1) confirm Zoom link for Zoe, 2) add a sticky note on remote calendar, 3) fridge space for extras. Anyone want to sing? :microphone:

Jess: I'll lead the singing — count me in.

Mike: I'll bring a small Bluetooth speaker, charged.

Zoe: Thanks — will pop in for virtual awkward singing! :joy:

Lola (People Ops): Perfect. Closing thread — see you all Friday at 3pm. Thanks everyone :heart:
